articleTitle: Performance degradation of RFID system due to the distortion in RFID tag antenna
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: In some Radio-Frequency IDentification (RFID) applications, the RFID tag antennas will be printed onto flexible substrates. After sticked onto different objects, possible distortion to the tag antenna such as bending of the tag will be caused due to the flexibility. In this paper, performance degradation of passive RFID systems due to bending of the RFID tag antenna is investigated. The antenna used is the basic folded dipole. Simulation results show that the performance of a passive RFID system, characterized by operating range, can be degraded significantly due to distortion. Thus, antenna structures less sensitive to this should be considered for RFID systems where this kind of effect might occur.

articleTitle: Measurement of microwave parameters of media by means of an open quasi-optical spherical resonator
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The technique of microwave parameters determination of substances based on application of high Q "whispering gallery" oscillations in a quasi-optical spherical resonator is reviewed. The dielectric permittivity values of isotropic quartz and transformer oil in the eight-millimeter wavelength band are obtained.

articleTitle: Passive millimeter-wave imaging system
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The characteristics of a 16-channel mechanically scanned radiometric imaging system, which has been developed in the 8-mm wavelength-range, are discussed. The radiometric array was designed using straight receivers with input low-noise amplifiers operating in 33-38 GHz frequency-band. The system produces a field-of-view image of 90/spl deg//spl times/16/spl deg/ in 10 seconds.

articleTitle: Traveling wave gyroton with double mode operations
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The kinematics theory is formulated and the traveling wave gyroton (TWG) is investigated on its basis at interaction previously rectilinear relativistic electrons beam (REB) with the EH/sub 11/ and HE/sub 11/ waves of goffered waveguide. It is shown, that TWG with REB has the same mechanism independent of an initial phase, as well as a resonance gyroton, that allows to predict high EFFICIENCY of the device which is coming nearer to 100%. It is revealed, that non-axial electrons of the wide REB in TWG have a combined Cherenkov-type gyrotrons of interaction with EH/sub 11/ and HE/sub 11/ waves, due to what the TWG EFFICIENCY with wide REB is much higher than in resonance gyrotons.

articleTitle: Universal device for motor-oil quality control
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results of motor oil investigations by EPR-method are presented. It is found that the actual quality of the utilized motor oil can be determined from the EPR. The experimental sample of the apparatus for motor oil control and corresponding express-method are designed.

articleTitle: Microwave pipe corrosion detector
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The paper presents the results of design, manufacture and research of a microwave detector for detecting the pipe corrosion under an optically opaque coating and protective coating separation. The detector operates in the 5 mm wave band. A minimum diameter of the detected defect is 5-8 mm with an antenna horn aperture diameter of 60 mm. The antenna horn diameter may be changed. The device consists of two blocks: EHF sensor and microprocessor unit with graphic LC-display. Power supply is 220 V, 50 Hz and 8 W.

articleTitle: Smart antenna technique for wireless communications
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The smart antenna has to optimize reception and radiation patterns dynamically in response to the signal environment. For this purpose smart antenna base station combines an antenna array with powerful digital signal processing unit. Therefore it needs to develop a high performance tracking algorithm for the base station. In this paper we propose a method of interchannel processing and an economic vector operations RLS tracking algorithm with linear complexity for a smart antenna base station processor. We present a comparison of computational complexity with the conventional RLS algorithm and numerical results.

articleTitle: Investigation of the sparse antenna array properties in the radio-imaging systems
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The new spheres of remote sensing system applications make demands for improving of the mass-size and economic characteristics of airborne portable radio-imaging systems, i.e. large aperture systems. First of all these demands are concerned with antenna structures. Application of sparse antenna structures offers the possibility of decreasing the number of antenna feeder elements which improves the above-mentioned performances of these systems. This paper is devoted to the study of the properties of sparse antenna arrays and their application in radio-imaging systems.

articleTitle: Telecommunication systems analytical simulation
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Proposes a new technique of distributed telecommunication networks research. It is based on penetration of parameters, determined analytically, into simulated parameters and vice versa. Introduction of this principle has made analytical and simulation methods widely usable. The results obtained allow one to: consider the influence of equipment unreliability on transmission capacity; simulate the control of packet routing, ensuring the flat loading of outbound channels; and create algorithms of routing method information support.

articleTitle: First cathode simulation in crossed-field devices
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Among all crossed-field systems special attention was given to surface wave devices. The operation of these devices has been insufficiently studied. To rectify this, analysis test data of the mathematical model for surface wave devices was observed. This model allowed one to simulate the secondary emission via the first cathode.

articleTitle: Technique of changeable frequency settings for FHSS radio line entering into synchronism and the methods for estimation of its interference immunity
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Described in this work is FHSS radio line entering into synchronism, as well as the main results of estimation of interference immunity for the algorithms of communication establishment.

articleTitle: Application of lead frames of semiconductor devices in microwave hybrid IC technology
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The advantages of the beam-lead lead-frame technology application to provide the connection between the semiconductor devices and the microstrip lines of the PCB are given. The distinctive features of the lead-frame fabrication technology and the HIC assembly using the frames are also pointed out.

articleTitle: The adaptive method of complex amplitudes in spectral models of microwave devices
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The modification of the method of complex amplitudes for simulation of RF fields in microwave tube slow-wave circuits is proposed. It allows one to increase the broadbandness of the spectral models based on this method, up to values of the similar parameter obtained based on the method of instantaneous values models. All the advantages of complex amplitudes usage are retained. Modification is in the continuous monitoring of an electron beam oscillations spectrum with periodic adjustment of a set of model base frequencies. An example of the offered adaptive method applicability domain is given.

articleTitle: Interactivity creation in satellite broadcasting network
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Considers the variants of channel setup within the satellite TV broadcasting network, consisting of central transmitting satellite station (CTSS) and receiving satellite servers (RSS). Set-up of backward channels (from users to CTSS) will make it possible to support dialog services, for example, teletext, storing services, Internet access, etc.

articleTitle: VHDL-AMS extensions for frequency domain harmonic balance simulation
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: VHDL has been shown to be an effective means of modeling complex electronic devices. Initially targeted as handling digital devices, it was later extended to Analog and Mixed Signal devices. In this paper, the authors show how VHDL can be extended further to accommodate microwave and RF modeling for use with Harmonic Balance Simulators. The authors refer to this extended modeling capability as VHDL-FD, and provide an example of applying it toward simulation of a Gilbert Cell mixer and the new RinconTM simulator from Ridgetop.

articleTitle: The millimeter wave generation of a large-orbit electron beams in crossed fields
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Considered in this paper is the model of a large-orbit M-type oscillator. Theoretical analysis of oscillator energy characteristics is conducted on shortening the operating wavelength.

articleTitle: New generation of geostationary mobile communication satellite - Thuraya. Complex usage
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Thuraya provides a GSM-based satellite telecommunications platform. This provides roaming via GSM networks all over the world. Coverage area: Europe, North and Central Africa, the Middle East and Indian subcontinent. Modulation /spl pi//4 QPSK. Channel bit rate is 46.8 kbps. 1.8 billion expected subscribers. Describes the possibility of multiple use of Thuraya space vehicle (SV). High energy potential allows use of this SV as a regional repeater.

articleTitle: Cyclotron protected integrated amplifiers for radar receivers
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The principle of operation, structure and main parameters of cyclotron protected complex amplifiers are described. The main advantages of these devices are reliable protection of radar receiver input cascades against microwave overloads and super short recovery time of their sensitivity.

articleTitle: Using of autodyne transceiver modules on Gunn diodes for determination of turbomachine blades deformations
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The levels of mechanical deformations of dynamically loaded blades in modern turbomachines in great extent define durability and reliability of gas-turbine engines. The report materials present the radar method and device for control of dynamic blades characteristics of gas-turbine engines (GTE). Primary converters with autodyne transceiver modules based on Gunn diodes are used in the discrete-phase method (DPM) equipment. The block diagram of the measuring setup and results of experimental studies are given.

articleTitle: Double frequency slot antenna on a multi-mode waveguide
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The characteristics of double frequency multi-element slot antennas based on a multi-mode waveguide are investigated by the magnetomotive force method, taking into account the correlation between the slot and the guide wall thickness. The slot with the length equal to a half of the wavelength is shown to be non-radiative at frequencies where higher modes arise. It was also shown that appropriate choice of the slot dimensions and locations could reduce the effect of the double frequency slot system on the characteristics of an antenna operating within the short-wave range.

articleTitle: Television methods for measurement systems with microwave visualization of monitoring objects
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The problems of television measurement systems design in which the visualization of monitoring objects is carried out under action of microwave fields energy are surveyed. The used measuring methods and cameras, the results of research, of systems metrology performance are discussed and perspectives of their application are defined.

articleTitle: Influence of antenna dimensions on response of ground-penetrating radar
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The response of ground-penetrating radar with the use of TEM-horns and Vivaldi antennas to metallic cylinders in free space and inside of a concrete wall has been investigated. The influence of distance between antennas on the position of time responses from closely situated objects has been experimentally confirmed.

articleTitle: The device for frequency switching time measurement of UHF oscillators
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The equipment for measurements of frequency switching time of solid-state UHF oscillators is described.

articleTitle: Effect of linear and circular polarized waves of SHF and EHF bands on human buccal epithelium cells
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: An increase of the negative charge of human nuclei has been revealed under conditions of the extremely-high frequency (EHF) irradiation during which the effect mentioned is greatly expressed for circular (right) polarization. At present, the universally adapted point of view explaining the mechanisms of SHF and EHF electromagnetic wave influence on live organisms has not been formed yet, though the trustworthiness of biological effects within the indicated bands is beyond any doubt. Research on the polarization characteristics of SHF and EHF influence on bio-objects at the cell level are of great interest. It is possible to suppose that the frequency and energetic properties of cell response will depend on electromagnetic field polarization characteristics (linear, right or left hand circular polarization). In experiments, SHF- and EHF-sources of electromagnetic radiation have been applied with the following parameters: the SHF-source had /spl lambda/ = 1.6 cm, output power P = 14 mW, power flow density - 700 /spl mu/W/cm/sup 2/, exposure time - 4 minutes. The EHF irradiation source (generator /spl Gamma/4 - 141) was fitted with a device for automatic frequency scanning over the range from 37 to 53 GHz (power flow density = 10 mW/cm/sup 2/, exposure time 20 seconds). Devices to obtain linear, right and left hand polarizations were used in both sources. Buccall epithelium cells were used as the object of the research. The cells were placed into the solution: 3.03 mM phosphate buffer, pH = 7.0, with addition of 2.89 mM CaCl/sub 2/. The effect of SHF and EHF fields of linear and circular (right and left) polarization was investigated. The influence criteria adopted was the electrophoretic mobility of the cells, i.e. the quantity of electronegative cell nuclei (ENN index, in percent) shifted in the electromagnetic field of a special camera with current 100 /spl mu/A and field voltage - 15 V/cm. Counting of ENN was carried out within 5 min. and 1 hour after irradiation. It was evident from the investigation that the SHF irradiation of all polarization types unchanged ENN index (in January-February). Under EHF irradiation condition (July - September) the of ENN index was maximized on 26.0% compared to control (36%). This process did not depend on the type of, polarization. In the experiments carried out late in February - March, when an organism is weakened and ENN index in control is low (32%) compared to standard norm, the EHF irradiation initiated also an index increase as for control, however, in this case at right polarization the increase was 25.3% and it was a maximal one. This tendency remained after 1 hour irradiation. The results obtained witness of the increase of cell ENN index under EHF irradiation and no changes under SHF irradiation. The data obtained witness of more expressed stimulating effect of EHF cell irradiation at right hand polarization. The effect is not stable and depends on the initial value of the ENN index.

articleTitle: Hybrid PLL/DDS frequency synthesizers
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Considered in this paper are the questions of frequency synthesizers design on the basis of PLL synthesizers and direct digital synthesizers.

articleTitle: Features of frequency responses of two-pole filters based on irregular microstrip resonators
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The regularities in behaviour of damping poles observed for a frequency response (FR) of two-pole microstrip structure consisting of irregular resonators, concerning design parameters, are investigated. The filters with adjacent and diagonal connection to transmitting lines with equal bandwidths and distinguished by a type of prevailing coupling between resonators at the passband frequencies , are considered.

articleTitle: Automated system for the measurement of diode detector parameters in millimetre wavelength range
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: An automated system for measurement of the basic electrical parameters of waveguide detectors for the 2.4-3 mm wavelength range over a wide range of diode currents and the input radiation power is described. The measured parameters of low-barrier diodes created on the basis of application of delta InGaAs-GaAs are given as an example.

articleTitle: Improving measurements of granular and liquid materials permittivities in the microwave range
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: This paper describes a technique to improve the accuracy in measurements of dielectric constants of liquids and granular materials. Two pieces of low loss dielectric material (plugs) are placed inside a waveguide to house the sample under measurement. The expression for the S/sub 21/ transmission parameter is derived here to take into account the multiple reflections within the plugs. The S-parameter method is employed in combination with Newton's complex iterative method to solve a nonlinear system of equations. Comparative numerical results are produced.

articleTitle: DRO with incline of focusing magnetostatic field [diffraction radiation oscillator]
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The features of the variation of start current, power and frequency of the diffraction radiation oscillator (DRO) electromagnetic oscillations from the incline of focusing magnetic field in the interaction space are experimentally studied.

articleTitle: Element of the W-band phased antenna array
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: An element of the reflective phased antenna array (RPAA) for the W-band with electrical beam-scanning is developed. The element contains a horn-dielectric radiator and waveguide ferrite phase shifter of a reflective type with magnetic memory, which produces a phase shift 0-400/spl deg/ in a 93-95 GHz frequency band. When a triangular grid element arrangement is used in an antenna array with 1.25/spl lambda/ spacing, the sector of the array scanning 2/spl theta/=30/spl deg/ is ensured.

articleTitle: Paraffin plugs removal by electromagnetic radiation from internal surface of the pipeline
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The numeric simulation of thin paraffin layers forming on the internal surface of an oil pipeline is carried out, using a moving electromagnetic radiation emission source. The time of total pipeline cleaning of the paraffin is determined depending on its thickness, initial oil temperature, power and frequency of the microwave source.

articleTitle: Radiation from electrically long slots
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The long longitudinal slots cut in the broadwall of a rectangular waveguide are investigated by the method of magnetomotive forces. The thickness of the waveguide walls is taken into account in the numerical calculations. Computer analysis showed the optimization possibility of energy characteristics of leaky-wave antennas on the basis of long longitudinal slots.

articleTitle: The compact dual-band microstrip antenna with the close resonant frequencies ratio
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The paper presents the results of theoretical and experimental investigations of dual-band low-profiled microstrip antennas, operating in the upper side of C-band. The ratio of mean frequencies in both frequency bands is about 1.05-1.1. These antennas can be used in telemetric and communication multichannel systems.

articleTitle: Choosing the architecture of information-analytical system for networks and radio-line simulation
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Substantiates the choice of architecture of information-analytical system for networks and radio-line simulation. Two-tier architecture, which is commonly used for design of corporate information systems, does not cope with the tasks of automatic calculations of EM compatibility, coverage zones, path profiles, etc. Multi-tier architecture can be an alternative.

articleTitle: On the hard excitation in O-type resonance oscillator with long-time interaction
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: An analytical theory of hard excitation in a long-time-interaction of an O-type resonance oscillator is developed with the assumption of small amplitude of radio frequency electric field. An expression for the steady-state amplitude is obtained. The existence of the applicability domain of this theory is proved. Four initial intervals of hard excitation are found.

articleTitle: Pulse of transition radiation of electron bunch in semiinfinite waveguide
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: In the present paper the process of excitation of wideband transition radiation during the injection of an electron bunch into a semi-infinite cylindrical dielectric-filled waveguide, which is shorted out by metal wall at the injection side, has been studied theoretically.

articleTitle: Telephony and data transmission via cable TV networks
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Vimcom Optic Co. suggested the solution of the problem of telephony and data transmission via cable TV networks. These solutions are based on technologies and equipment of the Motorola Corporation, which has great experience in the field of investigation of products for HFC networks and work in the RF environment. At present Motorola is the leader in the field of cable modem production. It delivers all the necessary equipment for creation of cable TV networks and organization of such services as interactive TV, IP telephony, Internet data transmission and Internet access.

articleTitle: Uncertainty elimination for the phase microwave meter of small distances
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Considered in this paper are the methods of measurement uncertainty elimination using a phase method. A microwave-based device for the measurement of small distances on the basis of phase radar methods is presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Design of polarization tracts for C-band satellite antennas with two combined receiving-transmitting channels
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Opportunities of achievement of the polarization crosstalk level of 27 dB in the C-band tracts of satellite communication systems with 500 MHz reception and transmission bands on the basis of the introduction of the absorbing diplexers into a two-port tract are considered.

articleTitle: Microwave technologies in Tatarstan forestry. Experience of seven-year activity
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results of seven years of shared operation with the Tatar wood experimental station are featured in the report. The ecologically pure process technology of a pine and fur-tree seed for germination rising is designed.

articleTitle: Radar sensor for vehicle cruise control applications
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: This paper deals with research efforts relating to radar sensors using millimeter wave technology, in particular to autonomous radars which are used for forward looking and to detect the distance and relative velocity of car ahead. The fundamental requirements to on-board radar equipment are formulated. Some experimental results of this radar research are presented.

articleTitle: Tunable filter based on ferroelectric films
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Microwave four-pole tunable waveguide filter containing eight planar SrTiO/sub 3/ film ferroelectric capacitors is presented. The frequency tuning of the filter is due to the variation of ferroelectric capacitance with dc controlling voltage. Parameters of the filter are following: the central frequency is 27 GHz, the band width for 1 dB level is 2.7%, the range of tuning is 1.1 GHz, insertion losses are not more than 4.2 dB.

articleTitle: Mutual fluctuations between carriers in a broadband millimeter-wave communication system
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Mutual fluctuations between two carriers in a broadband millimeter-wave communication system may be observed from the heterodyne signal spectrum of the carriers. Laboratory measurements made on equipment developed for local multipoint distribution system (LMDS) applications indicated the degradation in the heterodyne spectrum was mainly in the form of increased background noise with L(f) close to the beat-tone carrier essentially unaffected. Synchronization and orthogonal relationship between the carriers are therefore well preserved by the millimeter-wave link. This property is a key requirement for supporting modulation schemes with high spectral efficiency.

articleTitle: Oscillations steadying in orotron with hard excitation
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Based on the analytical theory using the successive approximation method, the behaviour of resonance microwave oscillators of the orotron-type is investigated in the steady-state mode and stabilizing one of the hard excitation oscillations and the slow variations of the accelerating voltage. The dependences of the stationary amplitude of the orotron and stabilizing time of oscillations on the transient electron angle are calculated. The analysis of average characteristics is performed for the quasistatic approximation.

articleTitle: Topography of wake-fields in semiinfinite dielectric waveguide
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The problem on excitation of field by relativistic charge in semi-infinite dielectric waveguide has been solved previously. There the appearance of rear front of wake wave was predicted and asymptotic field expressions were obtained. In this paper we found the exact solution of this problem.

articleTitle: Numerically-analytical method for research of transporting and focusing of thin beams in the electrodynamic structures
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The problem of formation of high-current beams of charged particles demands the solution of self-consistent nonlinear electrodynamic problems. The computing complexities increase, if there are the following factors: strong nonlinear effects, unstable modes, and virtual cathode. The development of numerical-analytical methods for the solution of such problems is difficult. To overcome this the method of small parameter decomposition arising in the multiscaling of physical quantities is presented in the paper.

articleTitle: Optimization task of calculation of multiservice CATV network having minimal cost
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Creation of multiservice CATV networks is regarded as an integration of different services within the limits of a network. The integration, in its turn, results in necessity of using new approaches to networks calculation in order to provide the required quality for each service. Presented in this paper is a method for the calculation of a multiservice CATV network of minimal cost, taking into account the limitations for each type of traffic. The examples of calculation are given.

articleTitle: PRK-001 non-contacting radar flow meter for double-phase gas-and-liquid flows
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results are presented for the PRK-001 non-contacting radar flow meter for double-phase gas-and-liquid flows. The flow meter provides online component flow metering of a well production product at gas condensate fields (GCF) without any preliminary separation for fractions. It works on the principle of componentwise measuring of the gas-and-liquid mixture rate and density in the millimeter wave range. The PRK flow meter provides standard digital protocols of data exchange with a field automated control system for technological processing. Stock production has been organized in order to equip some of Gazprom's enterprises.

articleTitle: Frequency domain reflectometry of buried objects using wideband antennas
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Antenna design for ground penetrating radar (GPR) requires to take into account a number of features related to subsurface sensing. Usually, such antennas are placed very closely to the object surface under investigation. They should be wideband to ensure good resolution, capable to operate on low frequencies to provide reasonable penetration depth, and be sufficiently sensitive and portable. Here we present the results of comparative analysis performed for two types of most popular antennas - the unidirectional spiral antenna and the tapered-slot antenna (TSA) of Vivaldi type, designed and fabricated by the authors.

articleTitle: New type of planar resonators and their applications for MW pass-band filter
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: New type of planar resonators with elevated value of Q-factor is considerated. A tunable pass-band filter based on planar ring resonators with tuning due to ferroelectric varactors was designed and tested.

articleTitle: Microwave oscillators on the basis of silicon IMPATT diodes used in the mm-band integrated circuits
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: We have developed, fabricated and tested an oscillator module of microstrip design on a silicon double-drift IMPATT diode. It has provided output power of /spl sim/40-50 mW in the 8 mm wavelength range. IMPATT diode design involves titanium nitride interstitial phases. This provided high quality and heat tolerance of ohmic contacts.

articleTitle: Oscillators based on nanoelectronic device structures containing resonant-tunneling diodes
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Two schematic implementations of various signal oscillators based on nanoelectronic device structures containing resonant-tunneling diodes are presented. These device structures can be used for different types of signal generation including harmonic and chaotic.

articleTitle: Far field pattern formation features of a two-element antenna array consisting of Z-radiators
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results of theoretical and experimental analysis of a single zigzag antenna (Z-radiator) radiation field, and that of a zigzag antenna as the radiator of a two-element antenna array are presented. The formation features of the directional and polarisation characteristics of the antenna array consisting of Z-radiators and the frequency band and design properties of the antenna are revealed.

articleTitle: On the opportunity of the using of secondary emission for the creation of vacuum microwave transistor
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Prospects of the application of multipactor for the emission of electron beams and amplification of microwave signal are considered. A new class of vacuum microwave amplifiers based on this mechanism is presented. Their properties and performances are analyzed.

articleTitle: Ion dynamics and self-acceleration effect of ions in high current diodes
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The ion dynamics in the high current diodes is considered. The effect of self-acceleration of ions at the front of the ion stream from the anode plasma is determined and investigated. The essential influence of the effect of self-acceleration of ions on the focusing of an electron beam in needle diodes is shown.

articleTitle: Simulation of microwave tube collectors
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The problem of microwave tube collectors simulation using two- and three-dimensional codes (EOS-2 and EDS-3) are considered. The self-consistent solution of the fields and electron trajectories on the two dimensional levels have been obtained taking into consideration the secondary electrons from collector surfaces. The method of calculation of the asymmetric collectors is developed on the basis of a 3D model of electron beams. The examples of TWT's collector calculation are given.

articleTitle: Comparison of interference effects caused by wide-band and narrow-band radio-frequency radiation
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: A statistical approach was developed for the comparison of interference effects in an electronic system caused by wide-band and narrow-band radio-frequency radiation. The probability density dependence on interference signal power is obtained. Computer simulation based on the measured characteristics of a real test system confirmed our theoretical conclusions.

articleTitle: "Information Society Technologies" - European programme of the XXI century infocommunication development
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: This paper provides a review of the main key directions of the European research programme known as the Information Society Technologies (IST) Program. Some of the projects within the scope of the program are briefly described. One of the Russian enterprises is now participating in such a project.

articleTitle: The activity of the central nervous system influenced by microwaves
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results of bioelectric brain activity analysis by a nonlinear dynamics method based on the Grassberger-Procaccia algorithm are presented. It was observed that the preserving of the brain interhemisphere asymmetry was influenced by microwaves, but its degree is lower than in control mode. It was demonstrated that synchronization of oscillation processes for both brain hemispheres are possible after removing the irradiation.

articleTitle: Microstrip sensor-based meter of dielectric properties of liquids
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: A meter for measuring liquid dielectric properties is described. The possibility of developing instruments for determination of liquid mixtures is demonstrated taking milk as an example.

articleTitle: Investigation of a forward looking motor vehicle radar with frequency modulation
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: A Front Survey Automobile Radar system with frequency modulation (FM) of a sounding signal is esteemed. Problems of creation of similar radar systems are discussed. Allowing experience of scientific collective on creation of the radar system of a forward view, the outcomes of experimental researches of the automobile radar system with FM of a new generation are resulted in the report. The outcomes of full-scale tests have confirmed high performance and self descriptiveness of the radar system for mission control of transport means. The analysis of results of tests has allowed determining steps of further improvement of technical characteristics of the considered radar system, and also - area of operational use of the radar system of the similar class.

articleTitle: Signals coherent subtraction in semiconductor synchronized microwave oscillators
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The signals coherent subtraction mode in the synchronized Gunn diode oscillator is theoretically described and experimentally investigated. We have detected high sensitivity of the investigated operation mode to the change of Gunn diode natural frequency and oscillation power. Coherent subtraction mode can be used in semiconductor synchronized microwave oscillators for the high-precise indication of parameters of objects being placed in the resonator system of the oscillator.

articleTitle: Coplanar power splitter analysis for the miniaturization of instantaneous frequency measurement subsystems
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Based on design equations taken from the conformal mapping theory, the authors have investigated the frequency response of a miniaturized coplanar power splitter for instantaneous frequency measurement subsystems application. Devices in different scales are fabricated and measured. The results of insertion loss through both arms of each structure are presented and compared. The devices were made on both RT/duroid 6010 and glass fibber by the silk screen technique.

articleTitle: Polarization characteristics of the electric dipole located above a plane screen
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Using the 3D radiation problem solution for an electric dipole arbitrarily oriented and located above a plane metal rectangular screen, the amplitudes and phase differences of orthogonal components of the radiation far field in the arbitrary direction of observation are calculated. The algorithms are produced to determine the conditions for providing the circularly polarized radiation in the given direction of the main observation planes of the dipole-screen system.

articleTitle: Field of two element array consisting of spiral feeders
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results of theoretical and experimental investigations of the polarization characteristics for a two-element array consisting of cylindrical spiral radiators under different excitations are presented. The estimation of antenna array interelement mutual coupling degree during the formation of the given far field pattern with controlled polarization is performed.

articleTitle: New generation of reporting relay stations
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Presents the results of design, testing and trial operation of reporting relay stations (RRS) of 7-40 GHz frequency band intended for TV and radio programme transmission. Characteristic features and performance specifications are given.

articleTitle: Conception of a generalized receiver in telecommunication systems
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results of an investigation of the possibility of using non-harmonic signals in telecommunication systems are presented. On the basis of a notional "number of signal degrees of freedom," a structure of a generalized receiver is proposed. This receiver identifies alphabetical symbols independently of the carrier waveform. It is shown that for some auto-correlation function types, the generalized receiver provides a significant advantage in noise stability.

articleTitle: The cold metallic activated cathodes for pulse oscillator devices
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results of the experimental investigation of cold metallic cathodes activated by barium are presented. It is shown that barium-activated cold cathodes made of molybdenum alloy and 47% rhenium (MR-47) with 20 /spl mu/m thickness may be used in pulse oscillator devices.

articleTitle: Chaotic generation in powerful backward wave oscillator
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Self-modulating regimes of generation in a powerful 10 /spl mu/s X-band BWO was studied theoretically and experimentally. The sequence of generation regimes and corresponding bifurcation values observed for a current increase were in good agreement with the simulation results. Finally, chaotic self-modulation was established at a current of 120 A, a power of 2 MW and relative spectral width of 4%.

articleTitle: Investigation of bio-objects response to external microwave radiation
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The given paper considers the results of investigation of a human skin response to external low intensity microwave radiation. Dissipation of absorption power of a biologically active point (BAT) was obtained. The value of maximum BAT sensitivity to microwave radiation was determined.

articleTitle: Theoretical modelling of thermal response in the tissue, made by contact flexible applicators at microwave hyperthermia
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: A mathematical model and the results of calculation of thermal field distribution in a living tissue during microwave hyperthermia in thermal heating with the use of the inductive type of flexible applicators which cover the cylindrical parts of a human body are presented.

articleTitle: Field focused by a paraboloid surface with large-scale roughnesses
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: A system of equations is obtained describing the field focused by a paraboloid in the presence of a large-scale roughness on the reflecting surface.

articleTitle: Construction and transformation of impedance grids for the scalar analysis of the axisymmetric waveguides and radiators in the time domain
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The procedures of the electrodynamical analysis of the axisymmetric devices based on quasi static definition and combination of the LC-circuits for 12 TEM waveguide, crossing the elementary grid volume, with borders in cylindrical coordinate system are described. For the axisymmetric devices the three-dimensional (3D) LC-grid transforms into the 2D LC-grid in radial cross section of devices with the subsequent transition to a flat R-grid. The algorithm of the analysis of these grids is mastered in the professional program TAMIC-R-H, ensuring operation in time domain with grids having more than 10/sup 7/ elements.

articleTitle: Possibility of detection of atmospheric fronts as areas with anomalous radio waves propagation by means of RASS and SODAR sounding
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The possibility of the shot-term local forecast of atmospheric fronts conditioning anomalous radio wave propagation in the atmosphere boundary layer is shown. A temporary and spatial scale of front originating precursors by SODAR and RASS sounding is determined.

articleTitle: Power and frequency characteristics of Gunn diodes with two active regions InP/sub 0.7/As/sub 0.3/-In/sub 0.4/Ga/sub 0.6/As
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: A new highly effective Gunn diode is offered. The power and frequency characteristics of Gunn diodes with two active regions (InP/sub 0.7/As/sub 0.3/-In/sub 0.4/Ga/sub 0.6/As) are calculated. The greatest efficiency /spl sim/14% and flow of target capacity /spl sim/15.5 kW/cm/sup 2/ are received on the diode with blocking metal cathode at frequency /spl sim/55 GHz; the width frequency of a range is /spl sim/53 GHz (from /spl sim/30 GHz up to /spl sim/83 GHz).

articleTitle: Direction and polarization properties of flat spiral antennas with arbitrary configurations
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The paper contains the results of comparative analysis of direction and polarization properties of flat spirals with arbitrary configurations in a wide frequency band. The results obtained are summarized in the form of graphical charts, characterizing the principal properties of the flat spiral radiators. Such graphical charts allow solution of the geometry synthesis problem, i.e. selection of the appropriate antenna geometry, meeting the given direction and polarization requirements.

articleTitle: Choosing the sequence sets for wideband signals
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Presented here are the results of the study of cross-correlation properties of composite Kasami sequence sets for CDMA-systems. Comparative analysis of the results obtained is given.

articleTitle: Realization of network parameters and average information delay calculation method in intelligent networks
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Summary form only given. This paper presents a method of calculating the information receiving delay in an Intelligent Network (IN). This method is based on an M/M/1 queuing theory model and allows one to calculate the receiving time of different services in an IN. Using the described method, it is possible to build an optimal network structure according to the minimum cost criterion and to any given limitations (for example, the service receiving time demanded by the subscribers can be a limitation).

articleTitle: Image retrieval in microwave sounding and microscopy
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Image deconvolution method based on the Tichonoff's theory of ill-posed problems is applied to the retrieval of images distorted by the instrument transfer function influence.

articleTitle: Hyperhigh-frequency laser
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: HCN hyperhigh-frequency discharge laser for biomedical investigations in clinical conditions is described. This laser is handy, easy and foolproof. It is pumped by alternating current. The gas discharge excitation is realised with the original electrodes placed outside the quasioptical resonator of waveguide type. The laser radiation parameters are presented.

articleTitle: Analysis of the measurement error of a multiport microwave phase-meter by means of a statistical method
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results of a computer simulation of measurement error of multiport microwave phase-measuring meter of complex reflection coefficient are considered. Mathematical model of a multiport transducer and statistical characteristics of measurement errors of module and argument of complex reflection coefficient of termination are represented.

articleTitle: Super-high-frequency study of biologically active compounds
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results of a study on melanin pigments are presented. Advantages of super-high-frequency (SHF) diagnostics in combination with optical spectroscopy and some chemical methods are shown for analysis of the melanins. It is found that origin and structure determine a wide spectrum of melanin parameters. Possible applications for protection against radiation and gene-toxic effects are discussed.

articleTitle: A method for improving spurious responses of a half-wavelength MSL resonator BPF
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: A new improvement technique for the spurious responses of a half-wavelength microstrip line (MSL) resonator bandpass filter (BPF) is proposed. Firstly, the basic operations of a tapped half-wavelength resonator are examined theoretically and experimentally. The application to MSL resonator BPFs are also presented. It is confirmed that the present concept is useful for improving spurious responses of the microwave filter.

articleTitle: Wideband tunable MM-wave GaAs generator
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The experimental research results of a waveguide-coaxial design of the MM-range broadband GaAs Gunn generator are given. A frequency band of mechanical tuning for the generator of /spl sim/23 GHz (from 44 up to 67 GHz) is obtained.

articleTitle: SHF-transistors parameters optimization by germanium doping of silicon monocrystal
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Optimization method of the SHF-transistors parameters has been designed. It is shown that germanium incorporation into SiO/sub 2/ reduces the leakage current and increases the breakdown voltage of MOS-structures.

articleTitle: Choosing the algorithms for numerical realization of deflation method at the calculation of microwave devices
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Summary form only given. Considered in this paper is the application of decomposition algorithms, and the method of order reduction in particular, for the calculation of nonlinear mathematical models of microwave devices.

articleTitle: Multiprobe microwave multimeter with absorbing wall sensors
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: This report is devoted to the analysis of a built-in multiprobe microwave multimeter operating at high level with absorbing wall sensors. Single-frequency and broadband measurement devices are considered. The multiprobe microwave multimeter was designed for automated remote signal and transmission line mode checking for high level power over a wide frequency range, and incident power, reflected power, and power passing to antenna, reflection coefficient modulus and phase measurement, and emergency situation prevention.

articleTitle: Vector network analyzer for the millimeter wavelength based on quadrature mixers
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The development results of a vector network analyzer (VNA) with quadrature mixers, which give the opportunity to measure S-parameters over a frequency range of 25-37 GHz, are presented.

articleTitle: System of monitoring of solar activity on basis of RT-22 CrAO radio telescope and small telescopes
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Some results of scientific elaboration and technical design of a local radio astronomical center of the Solar Service of Ukraine are given. The equipment at the Crimean Astrophysical Observatory will consist of the radio telescope RT-22 and three small radio telescopes.

articleTitle: Quasioptical electrodynamic systems of millimeter wave-band
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results of investigations of the quasioptical resonance systems in the millimeter wave-band are presented in this paper. Characteristics of the two-mirror resonators with different inclusions, properties of connection with outer tracks, dispersion characteristics, and multimirror systems were considered.

articleTitle: Calculation of nonlinear microwave conductivity of GaN Gunn diodes
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Summary form only given. Calculated in the present work are the dependences of components of a GaN Gunn diode's microwave conductivity on frequency in the terahertz waveband.

articleTitle: Periodically loaded waveguide structures
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to investigate a novel class of waveguide resonator structures using periodic metal septa for use at microwave, mm-wave, submm-wave and terahertz frequencies. Its aim is to show that this type of resonator can be easily realized with a single metal insert within circular, ridged and rectangular waveguide. One type of resonator which used quarter-wavelength metallic septa was employed. The simulated results for air-filled metal pipe rectangular and ridged waveguide resonator and filter structures using periodic metallic septa are presented.

articleTitle: Estimation of technical and economic efficiency of modern cable transmission systems
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Summary form only given. The present paper concerns the estimation of the cost of transmitting one kbps of information between two serviced intensifying or regeneration points (SIP or SRP). Different methods of signal multiplexing are taken into consideration.

articleTitle: Nonlinear scanning principle on the basis of two frequencies
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The new two-frequency principle of frequency scanning is described. The distinctive feature of the method is the use of the superposition of two waves with different frequencies from two sources located at different points of the waveguide structure. This field superposition is extracted by square-law detectors embedded in radiators. When the frequencies vary, their difference remains constant. As a result of such superposition, a so-called "wave of intensity", arises with the frequency equal to a difference of frequencies of the primary sources. The phase difference of the radiator is varied, thereby allowing the scanning of a radiation pattern.

articleTitle: Microwave meter of amplitude, frequency and phase noise of signal in 3 mm wavelength-range
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results of development of the microwave noise meter of amplitude, frequency and phase parameters for microwave signal frequency range 78,33-118,10 GHz are presented. Block scheme of the meter is described and the experimental results are given.

articleTitle: Noise performance and bias-dependence of Si/SiGe HBT's at microwave frequencies
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results of an investigation on the bias-dependence of the noise performance of Si/SiGe HBT's over the 5-25 GHz frequency range are reported. The noise parameters /spl Gamma//sub o/ and R/sub n/ have been derived from a model analysis based on measurements of the device scattering parameters and minimum noise figure F/sub o/.. The noise behaviour of the HBT and its bias dependence is compared with that of low-noise HEMT's and advanced polysilicon BJT's previously characterised and modelled in our lab.

articleTitle: Specific noises in mesoscopic structures
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The specific noise types in quantum devices are researched. Under some conditions, these noise types predominate above more conventional types of noise. The time dependent model of charge transport for mesoscopic structures is discussed, and equations for fluctuations of chemical potentials in mesoscopic structures were obtained. It is also demonstrated in this article that some new types of noise may exist in mesoscopic structures.

articleTitle: The influence of temperature on frequency response function of ferrite transmission line
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results of experimental investigations of temperature influence on frequency response of ferrite line transmission in L frequency band are presented. The possibility of decrease of temperature frequency response instability in free-deformed lines is shown.

articleTitle: Two-component thin-film microwave sensor of magnetic fields
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Describes an improved microstrip sensor with a thin magnetic film which can measure with high accuracy two components of magnetic field parallel to the plane of film investigated. The structure of the sensor consists of two horizontal and two vertical strip conductors arranged on the upper surface of dielectric substrate and, thus making two pairs of coupled microstrip resonators. To each pair of resonators input and output transmission lines are conductively connected. The thin magnetic film is on the lower surface of the dielectric substrate and consists of two parts with different directions of field of uniaxial magnetic anisotropy. Each of the parts of the film is situated against one of the pairs of resonators and is covered by a copper layer serving as a shield.

articleTitle: Modulating codes on the basis of modified Walsh functions
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Walsh functions are widely used for coding of information transmitted in discrete transceiving systems. Their use is explained by the possibility of error detection and correction due to a large code distance. One of the disadvantages of Walsh functions is the occurrence of combinations coinciding with code words of the origin collection. This does not allow the use these functions for receiver framing. Modified Walsh functions, used in MBOK modulation, as well as complementary codes of CCK modulation, have the same disadvantage. The aim of the research was to create a set of modulating codes for wide-band communication systems with quadrature phase modulation, which would allow one to conduct receiver framing by the input code chain.

articleTitle: High-efficiency operation of microwave power amplifiers
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Efficiency improvement techniques of transistor microwave power amplifiers are reviewed.

articleTitle: Nanoelectronic device simulator of NANODEV-type
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The principles and structure of the current version of the NANODEV nanoelectronic device simulator are described. NANODEV can simulate resonant-tunneling structures, single-electron structures, and structures based on quantum wires.

articleTitle: Satellite integrated telecommunication networks based on ATM-technology
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Considered in this paper is the construction of satellite integrated telecommunication network (SITN) on the basis of ATM-technology and multistation access with real-time redistribution of satellite channel resource. Basic structure of the satellite integrated network based on the Russian "Polycom ATM/TDMA" series, intended for information interchange between regional integrated networks, is described.

articleTitle: Gunn-diode amplifier with barrel-shaped open resonator
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results of an experimental investigation of a new design of Gunn-diode amplifier with barrel-shaped open resonator are presented.

articleTitle: Radically new technology for manufacturing of components and units of satellite communication systems
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: A set of millimeter-wave components and devices made by means of multilayer electroforming is presented. It is shown that the proposed technology makes possible quasi-monolithic multifunctional devices for communication facilities.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional effects in TWT-O with coaxial corrugated waveguide
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Influence of the magnitude of the focusing magnetic field on the efficiency of interaction in a TWT-O tube is investigated on the basis of the constructed 2D theory of excitation of the basic wave of the non-regular coaxial waveguide. The range of values of a magnetic field with an observed failure of amplification is detected.

articleTitle: Convolver on multileading-out acoustic-electronic cryotron
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results of a convolver on tunable acoustic-electronic cryotron elaboration are presented. The performances and parameters of a convolver depend on the frequency surface acoustic waves (SAW), amount and configurations of an arrangement of contacts of the multileading-out cryotron.

articleTitle: Analyzers of instantaneous spectrum of TV-systems with adaptive predistortion of signal
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: This paper describes the possibilities of designing analyzers of the instantaneous spectrum of TV systems with adaptive predistortion and correction of signals. Two concepts of such analyzers for this particular application have been demonstrated.

articleTitle: 155 Mb/s domestically produced radio-relay equipment
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: For the last 5-6 years thousands of kilometers of RRL SDH have been created in Russia using the equipment of Siemens, Nera, NEC, Harris, Alcatel, and Fujitsu. In Russia such equipment is not produced yet. However, work in this field was conducted for many years by various enterprises. At present, two Russian enterprises "Radius-2" and "Microtex-Paging" are at the development and testing phase of the first Russian radio relay equipment "Radius-155", using SDH technology. Simultaneously, preparation for the serial production of RRL-SDH in the year 2002 has been conducted.

articleTitle: Vector network analyzer for 3 mm wavelength-range
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: A vector network analyzer of homodyne type, capable of measuring all complex S-parameters for the frequency range 78.33-118.1 GHz, is presented. The analyzer's functional principles and experimental results are presented.

articleTitle: Low noise C-band amplifier
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results of design of low noise amplifier for C-band satcom stations are presented. 40 K of noise temperature and more than 60 dB gain have been obtained in 500 MHz bandwidth with WSVR less than 1.2. The amplifier includes four stages: amplifier, DC linear controller of supply voltage, low noise regulated GaAs FET bias and matching circuits. Minimal number of construction units ensures high reliability and low cost of serial production.

articleTitle: Investigation of nanocontact electron properties to the semiconductor islands
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Distribution of charge in semiconductor islands of InAs on GaAs surface and Ge/sub x/Si/sub 1-x/ on Si surface are investigated by atomic-force microscopy method with using conductor probes. Carriers of charge are concentrated on the islands perimeter that are shown in rough current peaks in this regions. Reason of this effect are indicated. Nanodimensional contact with /spl sim/10/sup -2/ mkm/sup 2/ area to single islands are fabricated, its current-voltage characteristics are investigated.

articleTitle: Corporate system MFG/PRO
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: This paper presents the description of ERP-system MFG/PRO. The MFG/PRO software is a comprehensive, open-architected, internet-enabled enterprise solution that has a set of new standards for functionality and rapid implementation. The software uses either Oracle or Progress databases, it is compatible with Unix, Windows, and Windows NT, and is accessible all over the Web.It helps executives to decide correctly about the enterprise management and gives them the idea of situation at the enterprise in any time.

articleTitle: The structure of the magnetic field near fractal cylindrical vibrator
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The multifractal measure defined by the current of conductivity on the fractal geometrical carrier is determined. The solution of the problem for definition the stationary magnetic field near the fractal cylindrical vibrator is obtained. The density of magnetic field lines near the Julia set is analyzed.

articleTitle: Efficient analysis of dielectric-covered waveguide longitudinal slots using analytical transform technique
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: In order to analyze dielectric-covered waveguide slot arrays, the performance of each element has to be studied with the presence of the dielectric substrate explicitly taken into account. An efficient method for the analysis of dielectric-covered waveguide slots is presented. An analytical transform is derived for the rooftop expansion and line testing (RELT) to evaluate the asymptotic parts of the admittance matrix elements in the spectral domain. The proposed method is shown to reduce the computation time and to improve the accuracy over the conventional method.

articleTitle: Effect of initiation of the n-type negative differential resistance zones on the current-voltage characteristics of IMPATT diodes in the strong microwave field
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Effect of initiation of the n-type negative differential resistance areas on the direct and inverse branches of current-voltage characteristics of IMPATT diodes is experimentally investigated.

articleTitle: 60 GHz phase shifters based on BSTO ferroelectric film
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Two variants of design of microwave phase shifters based on thin BSTO film for /spl sim/60 GHz frequency range are presented. Microstrip phase shifter demonstrates figure of merit F=22 deg/dB and continuous phase-shift up to /spl Delta//spl phi//spl ap/220 deg. Finline phase shifter demonstrates F=32 deg/dB and /spl Delta//spl phi//spl ap/250 deg.

articleTitle: TWT-O based on non-regular corrugated waveguide with rectangular cross-section
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The offered mathematical model is researched on the basis of the theory of energization of the longitudinal non-regular waveguide of rectangular cross-section and the efficiency of the TWT-O with an E/sub 11/ operating wave in a double comb slow-wave structure. Variants of such TWT in which an efficiency of more than 70 % is reached are found.

articleTitle: Phase stabilized fiber-optic link for transmission and distribution of UHF and EHF reference signals
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Experimental investigation results on phase stabilized fiber-optic link for transmission and distribution of microwave (UHF) and millimeter wave (EHF) reference signals are considered. The link under investigation operates in the remote optical self-heterodyne mode and contains two wavelength tunable laser sources, lengthy fiber transversal filter and Er-doped fiber amplifier. The designed link provides, in the frequency regions stated, transmitted reference signals with less than 1/spl deg/ phase instability with full compensation of the insertion loss.

articleTitle: Remote education system on the basis of satellite digital television network
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Remote education system (RES) ensures high-quality education in Ukraine, as well as integration of the Ukrainian educational system with the international system. It is one of the most efficient, functionally effective, economically advisable and socially attractive methods. This paper describes the method of quick introduction of remote education system, being a part of measures on crisis elimination.

articleTitle: Investigation of spatial homogeneity of microwave discharge plasma by means of optical emission spectroscopy method
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The actual spatial distribution of the luminescence intensity of a microwave discharge in oxygen at different distances from the microwave energy input band was studied with the method of optical emission spectroscopy. The examinations were carried out in a plasma generator on the basis of a ring waveguide slot antenna.

articleTitle: Superbroadband low-noise microwave FET amplifiers
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Described in this paper is a superbroadband low-noise microwave FET amplifier of hybrid-integral design. The amplifiers have demonstrated the low-noise figure of 6.0 - 7.0 dB at 20.0 - 25.0 dB gain, output power 35 mW (linear mode) in 1.0 - 18.0 GHz frequency band.

articleTitle: The using of partial regions method in analysis of optical directing structures with complicated cross-section form
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The universal approach of analyzing the dielectric waveguides with arbitrary cross-section form is presented. The approach is based upon partial regions method. The numerical results demonstrate the method's possibilities in solution exactness.

articleTitle: Electric field distribution in planar GaAs devices under backgating
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The distribution of the electric field in planar film-substrate GaAs devices under backgating is considered. It is shown that backgating can make the film exhibit a long-length region of a quasi-uniform electric field exceeding the threshold of N-type negative differential mobility.

articleTitle: Design and fabrication of low noise MODFET for 30-60 GHz band
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
