abstract: Described in this paper are unified design and electronic lithography-based technology of production of low-noise Schottky FETs. HEMT and PHEMT series for 3-60 GHz frequency band have been manufactured.

articleTitle: Pulsed coherent semiconductor Ka-band transmitters
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The development of pulsed coherent semiconductor transmitters for the millimeter wave range has made possible the creation of a new generation of short distance radars having high resolution and interference immunity. This paper presents the results of the design and production of high power pulsed coherent Ka-band semiconductor transmitters having high frequency stability, low phase noise and fast frequency switching.

articleTitle: Design of slot-waveguide antenna array for airport radars
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The design stages of ship-borne radar antenna systems for airfield surveys are considered. Radio engineering complexes designed are the result of the fruitful co-operation between Taganrog State Radio Engineering University and a number of industrial enterprises.

articleTitle: Creation of powerful microwave TV amplifiers with the purpose of energy-saving
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: In this paper the results of the design of high-power klystrons with a reduced collector potential are presented. It is shown that application of regeneration in klystrons used in the output amplifiers of TV transmitters makes it possible to increase the klystrons' efficiency up to 1.8-2.0 times. The aim of this paper is to create microwave electrovacuum devices (klystrons and TWTs) for TV and communication systems by use of the basic technologies. The energy-saving is obtained due to an efficiency increase. Those devices will replace the devices being exploited at the present time. The devices developed have the following advantages over the present ones: 1) 1.7-2 times higher efficiency compared with the simple design for klystrons. 2) Miniature design for TWTs.

articleTitle: Properties of bismuth-antimony alloys in UHF range
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Bismuth, antimony and its alloys are the typical representatives of a class of semi-metals, the electrical conductivity of which is 10/sup 2/-10/sup 3/ times lower than is usual for metals conducting well an electrical current. The alloys of bismuth with antimony have semiconductor properties in a wide range of structures at temperatures below 77 K. However, they are insulators at temperatures close to 0 K. The electrical properties of bismuth, antimony and its alloys differ considerably from properties of normal metals. Previously the use of semi-metal BiSb with percentage of Bi and Sb from 8 % up to 25 % was shown to exhibit a high-sensitivity and small inertia as detectors of UHF radiation where thermoelectric effect is used. In this paper we consider some questions of further improvement of UHF radiation detectors based on semi-metals with the purpose of increasing their sensitivity, improving stability of operation and their stability to external climatic influences.

articleTitle: Cascading microstrip filters based on quarter-wave resonators
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The possibility of increasing the selectivity and magnification of signal attenuation in stop-bands of microstrip filters based on quarter-wave resonators by their cascade connection is shown. The main advantage of cascade connection of filters based on quarter-wave resonators is the simplicity of matching the filters to each other.

articleTitle: Development of microwave multi-magnetron equipment for modern technologies
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The composition principles of technological microwave systems based on middle-power level magnetrons have been observed. Development prospects (with respect to product treatment uniformity and construction modularity) for various system types are formed and estimated, and experimental results are presented.

articleTitle: Quasioptical polarimetric microcompact experimental setup for scale modeling of object scattering characteristics in the near millimeter band
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The possibility of using the quasioptical waveguide modeling (QWM) method for experimental study of backward scattering polarization characteristics of physical objects and their scale models in the near millimeter (NMM) region of the electromagnetic spectrum is investigated. The quasioptical polarimetric micro-compact range (PMCR) has been developed and carried out for realizing the QWM method. The microwave part of the installation was built on the basis of a hollow dielectric waveguide (HDW), quasioptical devices, and transmission-line elements. The results of measurements of amplitude-phase backward scattering patterns (BSP) for a tested object for various polarizations bases are presented. For comparison purposes, corresponding theoretical numerical modeling data showing the possibilities of the QWM method are given.

articleTitle: GaAs microwave power offset gate MESFETs
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Describes microwave power transistors, developed in SRPC "Istok". Characteristics of power GaAs MESFETs and their applications are presented. Power MESFETs have output power density of 0.5 W/mm, power-added efficiency of 35% and thermal resistance of 10-12/spl deg/C/W (for MESFET with total gate width of 4 mm).

articleTitle: Development of back-to-back connected edge diodes for THz multipliers
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: A technology for fabrication of back-to-back connected diodes with edge (nonplanar) Schottky contacts to epitaxial layer (or heterolayers) on semi-insulating GaAs substrate has been developed. A concept of THz frequency multipliers on their basis has been formulated. The results of the structure design, test measurements and experiments are presented.

articleTitle: The concept of MITRIS based information WAN
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Presents the fundamental conceptual positions of creation of regional information networks on the basis of MITRIS system. It is shown, that such a network allows the establishment of a uniform teleinformation space in Ukraine.

articleTitle: Frequency selective waveguide-slot radiators
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The frequency band properties of two closely positioned longitudinal slots in the broad wall of a rectangular waveguide (one being positioned in the middle of the wall) are studied. It is shown that this radiator is very efficient and narrow-band, especially, when the slots are filled with dielectric. The system of two double-slots is considered as well.

articleTitle: Microwave distribution systems simulation with the use of "Serenade" software
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Presents the possibility of simulation of microwave distribution systems using the "Serenade" software (Ansoft Corp.) Describes the models of channels for digital stream interchange between the base (BS) and subscriber stations (SS).

articleTitle: A non-symmetrical reentrant resonator with partial dielectric filling
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The rigorous solution of the problem excitation of a non-symmetrical reentrant resonator with partial dielectric filling by H/sub p0/ mode is received. The resonant phenomena at trapped modes are analyzed and the influence of a structure geometry and dielectric permittivity of an insertion on their Q and position is cleared up. The analytic solution of the problem is found.

articleTitle: Electron-wave mechanism of oscillation amplification in open wave-guide with a periodical structure
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The transcendental dispersion equation was obtained and analysed by linear approximation. Such equation describes electron-wave mechanism of oscillation amplification based on coherent Smith-Parsell effect, which realized in the open wave-guide - periodic structure system. The capacity of energy transmission from electron beam to electromagnetic field by fast mode of space charge and extending wave discreteness which depends on electron beam thickness and frequency were determined.

articleTitle: Introduction of digital TV in Ukraine by means of MITRIS
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: It is shown, that MITRIS is the best system for the stepwise introduction of digital TV in Ukraine. The system possesses a number of advantageous qualities: high-quality electrical parameters and the possibility of manufacture of its components within the borders of the Ukraine.

articleTitle: Designing of microwave technological complexes based on the probability approach
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: To design microwave technological installations procedures based on the probability approach are offered. Ways of constructing probability models and methods of enriching figures of merit at their usage are considered. Examples showing the productivity of the probability approach are presented.

articleTitle: Application of basic-line centering device in aircraft construction
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results of laser system positioning units and details development in aircraft are presented. The installation accuracy is no more than 5 microns. This accuracy is reached by means of the square photoreceiver. The test results of the device on benches of the Kazan aircraft industrial corporation are adduced.

articleTitle: Design of FET- based power amplifiers for APAA
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Presents the results of design of FET-based power amplifiers with bandwidth 3 cm - 10 cm and output power of several watts. Experimental characteristics are given. Design peculiarities and assembly technology are discussed.

articleTitle: The radiation firmness of the GaAs-AlGaAs HEMT ohmic contacts
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results of investigation of the effect of /spl gamma/-radiation on the GaAs-AlGaAs field-effect transistors ohmic contacts specific contact resistivity are presented. The surface microrelief investigations and their correlation with the ohmic contacts parameters are presented. Investigations were carried out for two structure types subjected to various thermal treatment. It was shown that /spl gamma/-radiation may be used for parameters improvement; the radiation limit was determined.

articleTitle: Space telecommunication technologies at the beginning of the third millennium
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Presented in this paper are the fragments of the review that reflect both perspectives and problems of satellite communication and broadcasting at the beginning of the third millennium. The fields of application of space telecommunication technologies are shown.

articleTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)

articleTitle: List of authors
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Presents a list of the authors whose papers are published in the conference.

articleTitle: Low-element wideband phased array
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: A phased antenna array with wide-angle sector of 1D beamsteering, utilizing a minimum number of controlled elements due to certain space distribution of elements, is considered. The proposed array performances are shown.

articleTitle: Measurement of phase of microwave fields in the near zone of antennas
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: A way to reduce phase errors of the measured antenna near field for antenna pattern (AP) restoration is considered. The AP restoration problem in the near field measurement data exists in the microwave range. The problem is related to the limited opportunities for exact phase measurement.

articleTitle: Impedance dielectrometry of a dissipative medium
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Analysis of the possibilities of a complex dielectric permittivity determination on the measurements of the complex input impedance of the simplest antennas (dipole or monopole) inculcated in a relatively dense dissipative medium is performed. It is shown that the method of impedance dielectrometry allows us to avoid the shortcomings peculiar to the microwave technologies.

articleTitle: Characteristics of scanning short-pulse antennas
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: In this paper the directional characteristics of scanning short-pulse antennas are considered. The dependence of sector scanning on spatial pulse length and aperture dimension are given.

articleTitle: Computer aided analysis of near field radiation from an open-ended waveguide and horn antennas
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: On the basis of Kirchhoff technique the computer software for calculation the amplitude and phase characteristics of radiation from an open-ended circular waveguide and conical horn in near field and intermediate field zones has been produced. The dependencies of electromagnetic fields on the axial distance from the antenna are analysed and the far field zone distance boundary is specified for small waveguide apertures.

articleTitle: Low intensive microwave technology: principles and implementation
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Described in this paper are the principles of implementation of low intensive microwave processing in industry and agriculture. Those principles are based on the following concept: at each stage of life cycle the solutions accepted should correspond to condition of minimal expenditures of HF electromagnetic energy. The review of the basic key directions is given (the choice of cost effective processing modes, as well as the paths for creation of electromagnetic fields with required homogeneity).

articleTitle: Service area expansion for GSM1800 networks
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Presents brief technical information and the features of repeater application in cellular networks. Repeaters are commonly used in order to cover the areas with hills or other natural obstacles, impeding signal reception, Repeaters may also be used for "expansion" of the cell borders and enhancement of capacity utilization.

articleTitle: Single-layer radioabsorbent coatings on the basis of two-level composites
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Optimum parameters and radio characteristics of single-layer radioabsorbers are researched. Composites containing conductive inclusions, distributed in the environment, containing inclusions of the same type, and also in a dielectric environment with a dispersion of a resonant type were researched.

articleTitle: Irregular helical slow-wave structures for application in satellite TWT
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The excitation equations for the irregular helical waveguide are obtained on the basis of conversion of coordinates and using Galerkin's projection technique.

articleTitle: The K/sub L/ band-stop filter
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The investigation results of K/sub L/ stop-band filter based on wave-slot line are represented. The principle characters of such structures are the high attenuation level in stopband (around 30-40 dB), relatively low attenuation level in a pass-band (it is within 2 dB) and ability for manufacture.

articleTitle: The second far field pattern with independent operation on the radiotelescope BSA FIAN
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The second 16-beam far field pattern has been realized in BSA FIAN radiotelescope at the Pushchino Radio Astronomy Observatory. At present it is possible to perform simultaneous observations of cosmic radio sources for two scientific programs.

articleTitle: Near-field microwave microscope for investigation of dielectrics
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Elaboration results for a near-field microwave microscope are presented. The main parameters of the microscope are given. The possibility of its application for investigation of heterogeneous dielectrics and nondestructive quality inspection in the microwave range is assessed. An open-ended coaxial waveguide is used as a probe.

articleTitle: Physical modelling of light propagation through a microparticle using microwaves and a liquid model of dielectric particle
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The investigation of light propagation through prolate dielectric particles with different cross sections was conducted by the microwave modelling method with the help of a liquid model.

articleTitle: Some circuit aspects of low noise microwave amplifier design
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Several techniques exist concerning the design of low-noise microwave amplifiers. Presented in this paper are the results of the design of low-noise microwave amplifier using GaAs Schottky barrier FETs. The possibility of the achievement of a minimum noise figure for different amplifiers is shown.

articleTitle: Narrow-band beam filter
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The illustration of usage of the synthesis method of filters with losses is given as an example of development results of the narrow-band beam filter.

articleTitle: Single-ended power amplifier design using 4.8 mm gate width heterostructure FET device for high efficiency performance
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: This paper describes the design of a single-ended power amplifier at X-band for high efficiency performance using a state-of-the-art power heterostructure FET (HFET) device operating in class AB/F. The 4.8 mm gate HFET was modelled by scaling the small- and large-signal models representing the 2.4 mm unit-cell HFET. Conventional MIC technology was employed for practically realising the design. The amplifier exhibited power-added efficiency significantly higher than conventional power devices. The 4.8 mm gate width HFET amplifier fabricated achieved a power-added efficiency of 53 percent at an output power of 2.5 W with a small-signal gain of 8 dB.

articleTitle: Dielectric and mirror electrodynamic system
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: This paper contains the results of experimental investigations of the electrodynamic system, that consists of a dielectric cylinder and a metal mirror of spherical shape. Consequently, there were obtained spectral characteristics, including amplitude-frequency dependencies, their connection with geometric parameters, field distributions and Q-factors of excited oscillation types.

articleTitle: The use of passive radio extenders in cellular networks
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Presents the results of experimental check of passive radio extender efficiency within cellular communication networks. There are several possible ways of communication assurance when mobile station (MS) is out of the coverage area of the base station (BS). The first of them offers microcell application, when two antennas are used along with the other BS equipment. The second method assumes the use of personal high-elevation direct antenna and antenna adapter, which is connected directly to the MS. In several cases passive radio extender (PRE) can be used in order to provide communication for a small local group of MS.

articleTitle: Synthesis of optimized irregular chain of coupled TWT cavities
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The synthesis algorithms of geometric parameters of the coupling of cavities and slots for irregular slow-wave structures are indicated. The results of calculations of the parameters of irregular slow-wave structures are presented.

articleTitle: Local transformations of thin BN films under the action of STM probe
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Local transformations of mixed cubic/hexagonal BN films under the action of electric field of STM probe have been observed. If a magnitude of voltage pulses U/sub bias/ exceeded a threshold value, the STM action results in a local conducting protrusion with a height of the 10% film thickness, and a lateral size of about the film thickness. The film was peeled off the substrate at high voltages. It was noted that the films exposed to X-rays which shown more elastic properties. Possible mechanism of the observed film transformations is discussed.

articleTitle: Systems for controlling of reservoir supplies of oil and oil-products
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: High-accuracy measurement of product level in a reservoir is very necessary for determination of its mass both in static and in dynamic states. The exactness of level determination is connected with the exactness of distance measurement up to the air-product boundary. The designed system uses the radar phase method of distance measurement. Based on this level radar, the design principles and experimental results of a level control system for oil reserves in reservoirs and oil products are discussed.

articleTitle: Axisymmetrical dipole antenna array with circular polarization
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results of an investigation into the internal and external parameters of a broadband dipole array by the integral equation method are presented. The example of an array consisting of eight symmetrical dipoles with lumped capacitive loads is considered.

articleTitle: Microwave investigation of ferroelectric bulk and film materials
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: A method for measuring microwave properties of bulk and film ferroelectric materials has been developed. Waveguide is partially filled by studied material samples, whose dielectric constant /spl epsiv/ /spl sim/ 10/sup 2/ - 10/sup 3/ and losses tan/spl delta/ /spl sim/ 1-10/sup -3/ can be found from the frequency (f) dependence of S-parameters measured by network analyzer. S/sub 11/(f) or S/sub 21/(f) dependencies should be investigated in dependence on sensitivity. Studied films are deposited onto dielectric substrates, and film-on-substrate "sandwich" is centrally located in the waveguide. Software was elaborated to get this "sandwich" scattering parameters, from which film /spl epsi/ and tan/spl delta/ can be calculated. Proposed method of the film investigation requires no electrode deposition, so film dielectric constant and loss might be obtained at various stages of film processing.

articleTitle: Design of microwave hybrid-monolithic integrated circuits with the use of flip-chip technique
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: This paper presents the results of the design of microwave hybrid-monolithic integrated circuits with the use of flip-chip technique. Test results are given.

articleTitle: Computational method of topology of a microstrip low-pass filter taking into account losses
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The microstrip low-pass filter synthesis method is shown taking into account dissipative losses.

articleTitle: A 7.9-8.4 GHz transmitting module for high-speed digital radio link communication equipment
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Presents the development experience of highly-linear transmitting module used in radio link communication equipment with up to 155 Mbit/sec bit rate.

articleTitle: Numerical experiment in physics and microwave technology. Problems of simulation, calculation and optimization
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Given in this paper is the notion of a numerical experiment, its prospects and possibilities as a powerful tool in studies of physics and microwave technology. The requirements for mathematical models and calculation procedures are stated. The author proposes an effective technique of digitization for numerical calculation of differential equations. Propagation of an H/sub 10/ wave in a non-regular waveguide with circular cross-section demonstrates the high efficiency of this method. Also, a variation-iteration gradient method for dynamic processes optimization is proposed. The examples of computer analysis in the field of microwave technology are given.

articleTitle: Information-entropic method for estimation of invariant controlling systems
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Describes the properties of the combined system of information network control. The method is presented, determining the quantity of controlling information which is necessary in order to ensure the given accuracy of network parameters, while keeping the system invariant under various conditions.

articleTitle: Broadband microstrip filter
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Broadband microstrip filters based on quarter wave irregular resonators were investigated. The possibility of realization of miniature devices with fractional bandwidth up to 100% and with highly selective properties was shown.

articleTitle: Excitation of the nonlinear two-stage electron-wave system by external signal
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The steady-state characteristics of the hybrid O-type device for different input amplitude values are investigated. The analysis is carried out on the basis of the multidimensional nonlinear theory. The reasons for the output signal level decrease for particular input amplitude values are considered. The possibility of this phenomenon compensation due to interaction efficiency enhancement in the output resonance stage is shown.

articleTitle: Optical-acoustic method of signal frequency determination
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The acoustic-optical method of signal frequency determination is described. The estimation of precision of the method is given.

articleTitle: MITRIS-M system for creation of TV, radio and information networks within a ward
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Presents the results of development and adoption of MITRIS-M system near Novgorod-Siversk (Chernigov region). The system includes high-power 4-channel microwave subsystem with radius of service zone up to 50 km, low-power 12-channel microwave subsystem with radius of service zone up to 10 km and a set of low-power retransmitters in the decimeter waveband.

articleTitle: The waveguide ferrite phase shifter for a millimeter wave region
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results of the design and experimental investigation of a waveguide ferrite phase shifter with magnetic memory for 3 mm-wave phased antenna arrays are discussed. The phase shifter is based on a longitudinally magnetized ferrite rod and operates with circularly polarized waves. The system of magnetization includes a coil and a system of ferrite conductors. This construction of the phase shifter provides a fast response time, small energy consumption for the operational cycle, and high activity and Q-factor.

articleTitle: Investigation of Ka band phased array with ferroelectric phase shifters
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results of theoretical and experimental study of the microstrip-waveguide phased array printed antennas with phase shifters on the basis of ferroelectric films operating in millimeter wave frequency region of 28-30 GHz are presented.

articleTitle: Detection of the near field of thermal emission and its application for media temperature diagnostics
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Theoretical and experimental research of possibility to detect of near-field (quasi-static) component of thermal radio emission of lossy media has been carried out and prospects of application of near-field radiometric measurements for temperature profile retrieval are shown.

articleTitle: Distance laser meter for industrial needs
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results of distance laser meter development for different industrial needs are presented. The accuracy of distance measurement of the introduced system was 1-2 mm. That accuracy is obtained by means of converter of time intervals.

articleTitle: High-quality tunable superconducting circuit for MHz range
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The opportunity of fabrication of the high-quality (Q /spl sim/ 10/sup 5/) circuit mechanically tuneable in a wide frequency range for MHz applications is considered. The tuneable circuit consists of two single circuits made on YBaCuO films.

articleTitle: Interactive services in MITRIS system
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Presents the results of creation of interactive services, provided by MITRIS system. The services are described: reporting transmission via MITRIS network; radio channels allotment; Internet access; and radio-broadcasting. The authors examine the possibility of creation of the second and the third level services on the basis of MITRIS system.

articleTitle: The design of coaxial collinear antennas with series feeding dividers
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results of an investigation of the in-phase type collinear-coaxial antenna, with series feeding dividers and vertically polarised radiation field, are presented. It is shown that according to this scheme 2/sup n/-element antennas may be constructed and their parameters will meet the demands of base station antennas for personal wireless mobile communications.

articleTitle: Use of adequate simplification methods for speed and accuracy increase in controlling systems of integrated telecommunication networks
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: This paper describes creation of the software providing the operation of systems of automated control. Investigated is the application of decomposition methods and algorithms increasing the quality and speed of adaptive control systems of data transmission networks.

articleTitle: Optimum scanning for the control of information flows in telecommunication networks
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The authors have found Laplace-Stiltiece transformation for the time of message delivery to the receiver, as well as its response in the form of appropriate controlling frames. We have obtained the expression for estimation of optimal mean value of scanning period. Boundary conditions of scanning period have been laid down for several routing methods.

articleTitle: Spectrum characteristics of the rectangular ferrite resonator in a waveguide
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The rigorous solution of the problem about eigen resonant frequencies of H/sub ps0/ modes of the ferrite resonator in the waveguide is found. The dependencies of eigen resonant frequencies on material parameters of the ferrite resonator are analyzed. Some simple formulas in the analytic form for engineering computations of frequencies with a high degree of accuracy are received.

articleTitle: Experimental test of the natural scheme of electron beam energy recovery in a coaxial gyrotron
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: A possibility to increase considerably the efficiency of a coaxial gyrotron by only applying independently an appropriate voltage on its electrodes (without any design modification) has been shown. The used scheme is acceptable also for frequency step tuning and the deep output power modulation.

articleTitle: Software for wireless broadband system design
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The paper looks at the software of leading companies in the field of wireless broadband systems development. The basic characteristics of appropriate software and design systems are shown including the most typical examples for their implementation.

articleTitle: Tunable corner travelling wave antenna array with central excitation
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: A construction, calculation relationships and directive characteristics of travelling wave tunable array with central excitation are studied. It is shown that by variation of the corner angle of this array the constant direction of main lobe maximum of the pattern along bisector corner angle in the wide waveband is provided. Examples of calculating the characteristics of these antenna arrays are presented.

articleTitle: The basic directions of microwave technologies use in the agriculture of Tatarstan
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: There is a major interest in Tatarstan toward development of microwave process technologies in agriculture. Scientists at the Research and Development Center of Applied Electrodynamics and workers at the Ministry of Agriculture actively work in this field. The use of microwave process technologies is based on the effect of electromagnetic fields on biological plants. Using microwave process technologies it is possible to boost or to suppress processes of plant vital activity.

articleTitle: Controlling of digital frequency synthesizer with phase-locked system in ultimate mode
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The present work is devoted to the problem of synthesis of phase-locked system designed to operate in the harsh environment.

articleTitle: Unique circuits of switches, limiters, and attenuators based on pin-diodes and SB FETs
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Presented in this paper are the original circuits of switchers, limiters and attenuators on the base of pin-diodes and SB FETs, intended for operation in different microwave bands from 1 up to 18 GHz. Fundamental frequency characteristics of amplitude controlling devices are given. It is shown that the offered circuitry allows to reduce direct losses on 0, 2... 0,3 dB, while saving the required attenuation and decoupling levels.

articleTitle: Electronically tuned compact microwave filter
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: A dielectric resonator filter using a planar dielectric resonator (PDR) is described in this paper. The topology of the filter allows a high integration in a planar environment and has good characteristics. The possibility of shifting the resonant frequency of the PDR is described and a tunable UHF filter based on that resonator is investigated and the results are given.

articleTitle: Space charge limiting current in a coaxial transmission line
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: In strong magnetic field approximation, the analytic expression for the maximal vacuum current of noncompensated electron beam in a coaxial drift camera is obtained. A comparison of maximal currents in coaxial and cylindrical configurations is carried out.

articleTitle: Multisystem TV signals transcoder
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Presented in this paper are the results of the development of a multisystem transcoder of color TV signals (NTSC, PAL, SECAM), combining a wide range of functionalities and rather low cost. Creation of such transcoder is based on the use of the opportunities of TV signal digital processing. Transcoder flow chart and operating diagram are given.

articleTitle: YPMA-01 non-contacting radar level meter for hydrocarbon materials and products of their processing stored in tanks
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: According to the order from OAO Gazprom, a radar level meter was developed for hydrocarbon materials and commercial products in tanks of a height up to 20 meters with a fixed roof or a floating cover. As a level meter YPMA-01 is designed for operation within control and data acquisition systems using an RS-485 interface. Site tests are at the final stage at Gazprom facilities, and RF Gostekhnadzor permission for stock production will be received soon.

articleTitle: Bicosecant far field pattern synthesis in reflector antenna
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results of bicosecant far field pattern synthesis of a reflector antenna with aperture size of about 35 wavelengths are discussed. Two versions of the antenna models are used: 1) a model with a multi-element linear irradiator under the parabolic reflector shape condition and 2) a model with a single-element irradiator under the condition of special profiling of the reflector surface. The concept of a superposition of the partial beams of a parabolic reflector was used in both algorithms of far field pattern synthesis. The numerical results, including the far field radiation pattern, gain and aperture efficiency calculations, are performed by means of the CAD program "FARFOR". The computations are very fast.

articleTitle: Multibeam reflector antennas with displacement of exciters along focal axis
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Summary form only given. Antenna patterns and phase distributions of field sources in the aperture of nonsymmetrical reflector antennas with radiators shifted from the focus along and across the focal axis are investigated. It is shown that radiators displaced along the focal axis eliminate the shadowing of the radiating aperture and increase the directivity characteristics at a wider sector of angles. The later provides a larger number of beams in comparison with the conventional version of the radiator displaced across the focal axis.

articleTitle: Double-channel moisture meter
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Some aspects of a double-channel moisture meter development and the basics of related signal processing, are considered. There are many methods of moisture metering, but only one method can satisfy following requirements: high accuracy; high speed; and human safety. That is the optical method. To determine moisture by the optical method, a device must measure the light intensity, reflected from the material, on two wavelengths (analytic and reference). The first is the line in the absorption spectrum of the water, the second depends on reflecting properties of material. The main advantage of the double-channel architecture is the use of two optical receivers on analytic and reference wavelengths respectively. Two receivers make possible synchronous and independent processing of the optical signals, but they require calibration because of their parameter difference. A calibration lamp was included in this device to make periodical calibration of these receivers.

articleTitle: Subharmonic mixer for radio-relay equipment of millimeter waveband
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Presented in this paper are the results of design of integrated subharmonic mixer. The mixer is used in relay equipment of mm-waveband.

articleTitle: Experimental characterization and compact modeling of microwave injection-locked pulsed oscillators
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The problem of predicting, by computer-aided means, the complex phenomena observable in the dynamic response of microwave injection-locked pulsed-oscillators (ILPO) under both continuous-wave and modulated input signal drive is addressed. The proposed method makes use of characterization data taken on ILPO under both short- and long-pulse (or non-pulsed) sinusoidal operation in order to derive a nonlinear differential model in the stroboscopic time domain capable of describing the behaviour of the injection-locked oscillator under all operating conditions, including the undriven one with its associated intra-pulse amplitude and frequency variation (chirp). The experimental verification results presented show that the proposed characterization and modeling approach not only reduces the complexity of the model identification phase with respect to standard, equivalent-circuit based, methods, but also permits one to couple an excellent computational efficiency to a reasonably good simulation accuracy in predicting the ILPO response to real-world input signals.

articleTitle: Combined self-consistent resonant-tunneling diode model
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: A new combined self-consistent RTD model based on Schrodinger and Poisson equations is described. the model can be used for self-consistent potential/charge and electrical characteristics calculations.

articleTitle: Testing of the timing signals monitoring principles
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Considered here is the possibility of application of synchronizing devices in SDH transport networks. Such devices use the signals of radio navigation satellite systems GPS and GLONASS. Presented are the results of instability measurement for the timing signal of an SN-3836 device. The paper describes basic principles of creation of a system for timing signals monitoring.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of operation of powerful two-stage resonance amplifier with open electrodynamic system
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Presented in this paper are the results of experimental study of power two-stage resonance amplifier with a new type of periodic structure operating in 8-mm wavelength range. Authors give advices on the increase of amplifier operation efficiency on the basis of starting currents analysis for each stage.

articleTitle: Ion dynamic and electrodynamic structures originating in dielectric channels under transportation of high-current beam
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The electrodynamic structure of the internal area of a dielectric channel, arising at the transport of a relativistic electron beam (REB), is specified. The dynamics of ion streams, electron streams and plasma, together with the distribution electric and magnetic fields, are investigated in this paper.

articleTitle: Simulation of the three-dimensional electron-optical system of cyclotron protection device
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The authors present the results of simulation of the Cyclotron Protective Device (CPD) electron-optical system with a ribbon electron beam. We have determined the dependence of the form distortion of the ribbon beam cross section on the axis distribution function of the focusing magnetic field, which influences electron beam transportation to collector. The electron beam focusing conditions in the collector area are optimized.

articleTitle: Failure of digital IC under the influence of electromagnetic radiation
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The experimental data of digital IC failure under the influence of short pulse electromagnetic irradiation are presented. The energy of IC damage is determined as a function of electromagnetic pulse duration and repetition rate. Experiments have been performed in centimeter and millimeter wave band.

articleTitle: Standardization of the return path characteristics of the perspective cable TV networks
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Considered in this paper are the parameters of the return path of interactive networks, values of these parameters and the methods of their measurement. The requirements concerning the Russian standard of return path project developed within the scope of the TACIS/BISTRO project are submitted.

articleTitle: Informational millimeter-range waves application in complex with natural environmental factors for the human organism state correction
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Nine "doctors", given to a human being by nature for human organism correction, are presented in this work. They are: sunlight, clean air, water, natural-based food, dieting, physical exercise, recreation, good bearing, reason. Examples of medical devices, used in complex with the nine natural doctors, such as "MINITAG", "ELECTRONICA-KWC type 0114M", "MIT-1, LT-KWC", are also given in this work. UHF-devices for internal application in the human being organism are also presented in this work.

articleTitle: Distribution of microwave power absorbed in non-homogeneous timber layer
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The possibility of increasing the efficiency of timber microwave processing by microwave power distribution optimization was studied. The latter was calculated for different polarization modes of radiation incident on the timber layer, which allowed us to determine optimal methods of layer irradiation.

articleTitle: Amplitude-phase synthesis of a conformal array used as the primary radiator of a hybrid reflector antenna
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Under the Kirghouf approximation in the Fresnel zone of a major reflector location the problem of radiation characteristics optimization for a hybrid optical-type antenna is solved on the basis of analysis of the amplitude-phase field distribution in the aperture of a main reflector.

articleTitle: Monopulse antenna irradiator for a W-band dual-reflector antenna
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The outcome of the development and experimental investigations of a monopulse antenna radiator for a two-mirror Cassegrain antenna operating in a short-wave frequency range of W-band are presented. The scheme of antenna radiator construction, design realization, the processes of manufacturing, assembling and adjustment are described.

articleTitle: The problem of industrial use of microwave technologies
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The accent on efficiency of usage of UHF energy for processing of some materials is made. A description of laboratory installation for UHF materials processing is given. The main problems and directions of learning of the influences of the UHF fields on the substance are pointed out.

articleTitle: Far field pattern synthesis in small-element antenna array, consisting of the elliptical-conical helical radiators
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results of the investigation of the directional characteristics of elliptical-conical helical antennas, used as antenna array elements are presented. The main modes of radiation and correlation between the spiral system geometry and its winding surface geometry were revealed providing maximum radiation frequency bandwidth.

articleTitle: Principles of digital relay systems design
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Digital relay system represents a complex of one or a series of coupled radio-lines of point-to-point type. They consist of digital relay terminals (DRT) and remote control system. This work presents the principles of creation of digital relay systems for modern communication and data transfer networks. Peculiarities of microwave equipment of such systems are given.

articleTitle: IEMC (Integral Electromagnetic Code)
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: We present an Integral Electromagnetic Code (IEMC) developed for studies of high-current relativistic diodes, and supply examples of their applied usage. An in-circuit approach has been developed with an appropriate theory elaborated in order to analyze experimental data and numerical simulation results.

articleTitle: Local degradation of conductive microstructures of integrated chips at the effect of powerful pulsing electromagnetic fields
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The processes of local degradation of conductive microstructures of integrated chips are surveyed for the effect of powerful electromagnetic fields. The time of development of nonreversible degradation processes is identified and the geometrical size of local sites of metal film burn-up is detected.

articleTitle: Radiometric system for determination of biologically active modulation frequencies of mm-range radiation
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Considers a radiometric system for determination of biologically active modulation frequencies of mm-range radio-wave radiation. The system allows us to plot a graph of frequency dependence and objectivisation of the most active modulation frequencies within the range of a human body's biorhythms. The choice of modulation optimal frequencies provides an increase in the efficiency of quantum medicine technologies.

articleTitle: Practical use of mm-waves on the different stages of pathological process on consumptives
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The practice of use of Ka-band therapy on consumptives of different stages is presented in this article. It is shown that for cases at any of the three stages of the disease an optimal method of treatment with Ka-band therapy exists. I.e. points and zones of influence, frequency, duration and quantity of sessions must be chosen. A description of these methods is presented.

articleTitle: Beam pattern of coaxial exciter for multiband mirror antennas
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The far field pattern analysis by the Kirchhoff method for a quasi-omnidirectional radiator in the form of ancoaxial waveguide opened end excited with an H/sub 11/-wave is performed. The comparison of directivity characteristics for the coaxial radiator and the open ended circular waveguide both excited with H/sub 11/ waves is also carried out. The possibility of these radiators forming the far field main lobes with equal width at a certain level and for given different frequencies was shown.

articleTitle: Radio-wave imaging system for pipeline monitoring
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The possibility of radar system using of the space view for piping monitoring is esteemed in this report. The problem of such radar system application for remote control of pipeline attitude in a real time is discussed. Characteristics of radar accuracy are investigated. A conclusion about the feasibility of the radar system application for high-precision pipeline monitoring is made.

articleTitle: Pulse GaAs IMPATT diode of millimeter wavelength
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: A double-drift (DD) millimeter wave IMPATT diode has been developed. Pulse output power was 5 W. The diode is intended for implementation in oscillators and amplifiers.

articleTitle: Investigation of two-pole filter based on microstrip resonators with stubs
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Theoretically, in quasi-static approximation a distributions of MW voltages and currents along strip conductors of resonators of the two-pole microstrip filter having stubs are investigated. It is shown that two of the lowest modes participate in forming the filter pass-band, and the third lowest mode provides a rejection at a slope of transmission band.

articleTitle: Digital VHF data transmitting modulator for GBAS system
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The authors consider the possibilities of creation of VHF channel modulator for GBAS systems, in accordance with ICAO recommendations. A model experiment has been carried out.

articleTitle: Reliability increase in satellite communication systems for discrete information receiving
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Presents the technique of reliability increase for information reception. The technique is based on the use of complex signals with large bandwidth-duration product and their further compression in the matched receiver for the given system resources and transmission rate.

articleTitle: Influence of localization of cathode emitting surface on electrovacuum device properties
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The authors propose a method of quantitative description of regularities, related to the influence of dimensions and localization of different areas of the cathode emitting surface, on the volt-amp diagrams. They report numerical experiments in the field of cathode electronics, including the usage of the basic system containing cathodes with edge screening.

articleTitle: Development of measuring equipment for active optoelectronic components
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The result of development of a measuring complex of optoelectronic devices for fiber-optic communication devices is represented. Due to the intensive development of the optical telecommunication, the measurement problem of optoelectronic components for transceivers is of great practical importance. This paper reports on the development of effective measuring equipment for active components of transceiver modules at designing, testing and production stages. The control operations and measuring parameters are described.

articleTitle: Investigation of the electrophysical characteristics of a microwave resonator type plasma generator with partial plasma filling of resonating volume
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results of measuring a series of electrophysical characteristics determining the operation of a microwave plasma generator, based on a rectangular shaped resonator with partial filling of the resonating volume with plasma, are presented. It was established that the allocation of the microwave field and local electrical plasma conductivity according to the length of the discharge area shows a periodic character with alternating maximums and minimums. The changes of the temperature values have a rather smooth shape with a small rise near the place of microwave energy input to the resonator. Because of a space inhomogeneity in the parameters of the microwave discharge, the plasma generators of the type given are reasonable for use in such non-precision processes of plasma processing as activation of substrate surfaces of integrated circuits, cleaning from lacquers and polish, plasma-chemical removal of photoresist film coatings, etc. at the density values of microwave power of up to 7/spl times/10/sup 4/ W/m/sup 3/.

articleTitle: Changes in cell membrane properties, chromatin state, and electrokinetic properties of human cell nuclei under the influence of low level microwave irradiation
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The influence of microwaves on cell membrane permeability, chromatin condensation state and electrokinetic properties of human buccal cell nuclei was investigated. Microwave irradiation was found to induce increases in membrane permeability and chromatin condensation, and to decrease the electronegativity of the cell nuclei. The obtained data are discussed in connection with the mechanisms of microwave radiation effects on cells.

articleTitle: Ka-band power amplifier with series connected GaAs IMPATT diodes
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: In order to improve the performance of mm-wave IMPATT diode amplifiers, the series diode connection has been effectively used. Series connection of diodes at AC and their parallel connection at DC have been realized in a two-diode balance circuit. The amplifier circuit minimizes losses and overcomes impedance restriction of millimeter wave IMPATTs. The practical amplifier possessed near 100% combining efficiency at 36 GHz and had about 0.9 W output power at 15% power added efficiency.

articleTitle: Whispering-gallery mode resonators for millimeter wave radiospectroscopy
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results of a study of the spectral, energy and field characteristics of dielectric resonators having whispering gallery modes in the millimeter range of electromagnetic waves are given. The dielectric resonators such as disks, rings and balls were made on the basis of dielectric materials with low losses (quartz, glass-ceramic, sapphire). The design of effective resonant cells for millimeter wave radiospectrometers was the main purpose of the research.

articleTitle: Pulse microwave power source
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results of experimental research on output characteristics of a source of pulse microwave power made as two modules on powerful bipolar transistors are given. The source allows one to receive pulse power P/sub out,i/ /spl sim/1 kW (carrier frequency f = 150 MHz; pulse duration /spl tau//sub l/ = 0.5 ms; impulse frequency F/sub l/ = 10 Hz) on matched load Z/sub L/ = 50 /spl Omega/.

articleTitle: Carbon diamond-like film in GaAs MDS-structures
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: MDS-structures on basis of gallium-arsenide (GaAs) and carbon diamond-like film (CDLF) are experimentally investigated. The attempt is made to estimate influence of CDLF quality on volt-ampere characteristics of MDS-structures by use laser irradiation for improvement of CDLF quality.

articleTitle: Calculation of frequency and spatial separation regulations for fixed service receiving stations and radio facilities of other services
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: In the process of transmission of fixed service radio links it is important to provide the required frequency and spatial separation between fixed service receiving stations and radio facilities of other services operating in the same frequency band as fixed service stations. According to radio regulations, the frequency bands assigned to the fixed service are in most cases also used by the land mobile service, the radio broadcasting service, radiolocation service, satellite communication service and other services. Therefore it is necessary to develop and employ frequency and spatial separation regulations in order to economically and efficiently utilize the frequency spectrum. This paper describes a method for the calculation of frequency and spatial separation regulations for fixed service receiving stations and radio facilities of other services that interfere with receiving stations of radio relay links.

articleTitle: Integrated electrodynamics characteristics of coaxial microwave plasmatron
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The source of dense low-temperature plasma (plasmatron) is widely used in physical experiments and engineering. In this device, a cold working gas is blown through the discharge region The torch produces cold plasma. The structures and characteristics of plasma are determined by electrodynamics properties of plasmatron. The goal of this work is the investigation of plasmatron electrodynamic characteristics. Hence the electrodynamic characteristics of a coaxial microwave plasmatron operating at a frequency of 10 GHz are studied.

articleTitle: Polarizable measuring set for the measurement of device parameters based on metal-dielectric strip waveguide
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The results of elaboration of measuring super high frequency devices parameters set are represented. The measuring set contains a generator, an indicator and a circular polarization brancher (CPB) realized on a metal-dielectric strip waveguide (MDSW).

articleTitle: The series of antennas for LMDS base stations
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Broadband wireless systems, such as LMDS, are now emerging as a cost-effective means of providing a wide range of interactive services to subscribers worldwide. The hub antenna facilities are very important for the system efficiency. Such antennas must have a sharp sector far field pattern in the azimuth plane and cosecant shape in the elevation plane. A series of base station antennas for the LMDS system is presented. The description of antenna constructions and design methods of their key elements are given. The main functional parameters of the designed series are given.

articleTitle: The analysis of frequency selective structures with complex shape elements
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The principles of construction the multifrequency frequency - selective structures (FSS) are considered. All analysed FSS are the planar diffraction arrays. The mathematical model is constructed on the basis of method of integral equations. The results of the research can be used for construction the hybrid mirror antennas operating at several frequencies.

articleTitle: Microwave coplanar line phase shifter with paraelectric film (method of analysis)
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Phase shifter based on integrated paraelectric film has advantages in high operation speed, low cost and size, and a possibility to use in high frequency MMIC. The design of such a phase shifter requires CAD simulation. A coplanar line has been chosen after comparing of various transmission lines used in the MMIC. Finite element method is used for estimation of phase shifter characteristics: matching with the MMIC system, electromagnetic field distribution in the multi-layered structure, effective dielectric constant, phase shifter wave impedance, controlling phase shift and insertion loss. Clear recommendations were obtained for the best collocation of a paraelectric film and metallic lines depending on applied materials parameters and geometry.

articleTitle: Network productivity control
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Summary form only given. The paper deals with the problems of network productivity management. Some particular reasons for insufficient efficiency of a network are analysed. A conclusion is made that certain additional measures are required in order to support high efficiency of a network.

articleTitle: Scattering characteristics of Cassegrainian antennas
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: This paper is devoted to the analysis of the scattering characteristics of Cassegrainian antennas widely used for onboard radio engineering systems. The scattering characteristics of two-dimensional and three-dimensional models of three Cassegrainian two-mirror antenna designs are considered in the paper.

articleTitle: High-accuracy BWO-based high-velocity sweep generator
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The generator based on the back wave oscillator (BWO) with high speed (10 MHz/mcs) and high precision (10/sup -4/) sweeps is elaborated. It can be realized in any part of the frequency range where BWO operates (37-1500 GHz) Accuracy of ramp sweep mode of generator is near 100 kHz under at the sweep range 1 GHz and its accuracy of continue sweep mode is as in a frequency synthesis regime. Under this conditions period of sweep is at least two order less than at the best microwave sweep-generators.

articleTitle: Prospects of telecommunications development
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: Presents a review of the possible ways of telecommunications development in the present century. The authors consider all kinds of telecommunications including fiber-optical trunk lines and wireless solutions of the "last mile". Special attention is paid to new trends in telecommunications development.

articleTitle: Computer-aided panoramic vector analyzer based on a P2-60...P2-69 series meter
publicationTitle: 11th International Conference 'Microwave and Telecommunication Technology'. Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.01EX487)
abstract: The description of the design principles of computer-aided panoramic vector-analyzer based on the standard P2-60...P2-69 series meter and PC is given. The basic metrological characteristics are presented.
